claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Tinidazole is a nitroimidazole prodrug that requires reductive activation in anaerobic/hypoxic cells; at 2.5 uM in a 5-day aerobic pooled screen of human cancer lines it is expected to be largely inactive, with any killing attributable to nonspecific nitroreductive DNA damage rather than a cancer-relevant mechanism.
